title: HOUSE 99: A Native MotionLoom City Residence
teaches: Author a furnished single-storey residence with native MotionLoom primitives, MeshAsset planting and reusable compound city buildings.
Build tapered branches, petioles and individually curved pointed leaves from native MeshAsset vertices and faces with natural proportions.
Assemble recessed opaque windows, facade frames, balconies and roof equipment as native CompoundAsset geometry while preserving the house and camera sequence.
Coordinate a native 2D plan with metre-based wall, room, furniture and opening dimensions in the 3D scene.
Split wall solids around actual door and window voids rather than placing decorative panes on unbroken walls.
Animate a wall rise and roof assembly while preserving the room layout and opening dimensions.
Cut between exterior, living, kitchen, bedroom and bathroom cameras with the Scene activeCamera channel.
Combine visible lamp housings, emissive sources, seven fixed direct lights and image-based lighting for an architectural preview.
Use physical transmission material controls for thin glass while documenting screen-space preview and Weaver limitations.
Use matching CC0 colour, OpenGL normal and roughness/AO maps with metre-scaled UVs and separate paint, fabric, wood and stone finishes.
Calibrate a real HDR environment with authored direct lights and the existing day-to-dusk transition while preserving geometry, cameras and overlays.
Keep a 3840x2160 logical canvas and 2x screen-artwork transforms while rendering 3D islands at the 1920x1080 output resolution.
Bake camera-independent day/dusk SH9 irradiance with geometry occlusion and three diffuse bounces, then blend after the construction reveal.
Use box-projected local HDR reflections and a reflected-camera planar bathroom mirror, while preserving the original staging.
